flows.name: Driver Setup Flow
flows.description: How a test session is initialized from CI to the Appium server.

steps.desc: GitHub Actions triggers the daily test workflow.

flows.name: Happy Path UI Flow
flows.description: The end-to-end user journey for purchasing a policy.

steps.desc: User selects Motor Product on Home Screen.
User navigates to the About You form.
Test data is injected into the form fields.
A fresh National ID is generated.
Policy is confirmed and user closes the modal.

flows.name: Self-Healing Fallback Flow
flows.description: How BasePage intercepts UI failures to clear unexpected popups.

steps.desc: A click attempt fails on the confirmation screen.
BasePage catches the exception, searches for active popups, and heals the interaction.

flows.name: Negative Validation Flow
flows.description: How negative tests intentionally fail midway and trigger a reset.

steps.desc: Test finishes and BaseTest tearDown is called.
Driver is explicitly quit to reset app state.
